status_legend.verified: All listed acceptance criteria have current, recorded evidence.
status_legend.partial: Some implementation exists, but one or more acceptance criteria are unverified or incomplete.
status_legend.blocked: Progress depends on an unresolved owner, API, provider, or authorization gate.

status_basis: Statuses reconciled against PRD, Division, origin/develop dbfac42, the current nasar-frontend work including AAT runner 165038c, and PRs #10-#12 as observed on 2026-11-15. The frontend route calls PR #11's shared comparison runner and evidence validator with fixed fixture ports and a local policy. It does not call the real gateway, provider, or payment system. No real provider checkout or payment is evidenced. F-004 and F-005 remain partial; F-006/F-007 remain blocked; F-009/F-010 remain gated on owner APIs and provider evidence; F-013 remains blocked on integration and acceptance evidence.

features.name: Trusted purchase intent registration
features.description: Register and persist the buyer's trusted authorization independently of agent-controlled context.
requirements: Store owner, seller, product, maximum amount, currency or token, expiry, and remaining uses.
Use integer monetary units and immutable authorization records.
Expose an interface for users to create an authorization.
acceptance_criteria: A user can register an intent with all required constraints.
The trusted intent is stored outside the agent's control.

features.name: Deterministic purchase verification and authorization lifecycle
features.description: Compare each purchase proposal with its registered intent and issue a transaction-bound, single-use approval only when every policy check passes.
requirements: Validate authorization ID, seller, product, amount, currency or token, recipient or destination, and expiry.
Reject expired, mismatched, exhausted, or replayed authorizations.
Consume one-use authorizations atomically and prevent duplicate execution IDs.
Bind approval to the exact approved proposal so adapters cannot change its fields.
Return approved, rejected, or review-required decisions with reason codes and timestamps.
acceptance_criteria: Valid purchases pass and deterministic authorization violations fail closed.
Duplicate and replay attempts cannot create additional payments.
Every decision records an auditable reason.

features.name: Security gateway and payment interception
features.description: Provide the Fastify security authority through which all payment actions must pass.
requirements: Keep payment credentials inaccessible to the LLM.
Require gateway approval before any payment adapter executes.
Fail closed when verification is unavailable or the proposal is unverified.
Record verification and execution decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthorized or unverified purchases are blocked before execution.
No agent or adapter can bypass the gateway to perform checkout.

features.name: Prompt-injection inspection for listings and invoices
features.description: Inspect untrusted merchant content and PDF invoices for suspicious instructions and return evidence to the gateway and audit trail.
requirements: Inspect product descriptions and catalog listings.
Extract PDF invoice text with PyMuPDF, including hidden text-layer content where available.
Return source, suspicious evidence, flags, and extraction findings.
Treat inspection signals as evidence; deterministic authorization remains the payment authority.
acceptance_criteria: Malicious listing and PDF fixtures produce inspection findings with evidence.
Legitimate content can proceed when its purchase matches the registered intent.

features.name: Purchasing agent and attack comparison demo
features.description: Build the tool-calling purchasing agent and demonstrate the same malicious content against an unprotected agent and the protected gateway flow.
requirements: Provide clean and malicious product or invoice fixtures.
Generate purchase proposals using the shared PurchaseProposal contract.
Show an unprotected test agent being manipulated in a controlled scenario.
Show the protected flow rejecting the resulting unauthorized proposal.
acceptance_criteria: At least one attack succeeds against the intentionally unprotected test agent.
The corresponding protected transaction is blocked and its evidence is recorded.
A legitimate authorized purchase still completes.

features.name: GOAT AgentKit payment integration
features.description: Execute gateway-approved payments through GOAT AgentKit and verify their on-chain results.
requirements: Configure a GOAT Testnet3 wallet and adapter using AgentKit and viem.
Accept only exact gateway-approved transaction parameters.
Keep wallet credentials inaccessible to the agent.
Submit transactions and verify receipts and status.
Handle uncertain outcomes conservatively to avoid duplicate payments.
acceptance_criteria: At least one gateway-approved payment executes on GOAT Testnet3 with a verifiable receipt.
Unauthorized payments never execute.

features.name: Qatom MCP discovery and checkout integration
features.description: Wrap authenticated Qatom marketplace discovery and checkout tools so checkout is available only for gateway-approved proposals.
requirements: Verify MCP authentication, checkout permissions, and test transaction availability.
Implement catalog_search and agent_checkout where supported.
Validate approved parameters immediately before checkout.
Handle errors and retries conservatively to avoid duplicate payments.
Document actual Qatom capabilities and limitations.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated catalog discovery works.
An approved checkout completes where supported and returns a receipt or checkout reference.
Unauthorized checkout requests are blocked.

features.name: Audit records and decision evidence
features.description: Persist the intent reference, proposal, verification decision, inspection evidence, and payment outcome for each attempt.
requirements: Record authorization and verification decisions with reasons and timestamps.
Record execution IDs, platform, transaction hash or checkout reference, status, and errors.
Connect inspection evidence and payment results to the relevant proposal and intent.
acceptance_criteria: Every attempted transaction has an auditable decision and outcome.
A rejected attack can be reviewed with its original intent, proposal, reason, and evidence.

features.name: Authorization and audit dashboard
features.description: Provide a Next.js interface to register purchase intents and review decisions and audit evidence.
requirements: Display trusted intent, proposed payment, decision, reason, inspection evidence, and transaction status.
Show approved, rejected, and review-required decisions.
Provide a minimal interface needed for the end-to-end demonstration.
acceptance_criteria: A user can complete the protected purchase flow through one interface.
The user can see authorization, decision, evidence, and actual payment outcome.

features.name: Human review for ambiguous proposals
features.description: Route ambiguous purchase proposals to a human for approval before payment execution.
requirements: Represent review-required as a distinct decision.
Prevent execution until an authorized human resolves the review.
acceptance_criteria: Ambiguous proposals are visible for review and cannot execute while unresolved.

features.name: GOAT escrow and conditional settlement
features.description: Implement an optional GOAT-native escrow path for approved transactions, separate from direct GOAT Flow or Qatom checkout.
requirements: Build a Solidity escrow contract with deposit, release, refund, and dispute operations.
Bind escrow deposits to gateway-approved authorization and transaction details.
Release only on trusted, objectively verifiable fulfillment evidence; do not rely solely on an LLM judgment.
Expose escrow status and outcome in the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: A separate approved transaction can be deposited into escrow.
Release and refund paths work under their contract conditions and are demonstrable.

features.name: Delivery verification for escrow release
features.description: Verify agreed fulfillment evidence using objective conditions before the escrow release path can proceed.
requirements: Define verifiable delivery conditions for the demo.
Provide trusted verification evidence to the escrow release flow.
acceptance_criteria: Escrow release requires evidence that satisfies the agreed delivery conditions.

features.name: Integrated deployment and demo readiness
features.description: Integrate the components into one runnable demo environment and document setup and the demonstration flow.
requirements: Connect frontend, gateway, agent, and payment adapters through shared API contracts.
Show real payment outcomes rather than simulated success.
Document setup, integration limitations, and demo steps.
acceptance_criteria: The protected purchase flow works end to end through the shared gateway.
The demo shows intent, attack attempt, blocked proposal, successful legitimate GOAT payment, supported Qatom flow, and audit evidence.
